key_principles_applied_this_round: Article XXV: Unknown must remain unknown (R2-C3 prevalence stays UNKNOWN)
Article XXVI: No self-certification (cannot claim CI without push verification)
Article XXVII: No threshold invention (cannot claim 15-18 mmHg gradient threshold without within-cohort test)
Article XXVIII: No silent semantic promotion (cannot promote group-level recurrence to per-patient R2-C3)
Article XXXII: State strongest alternative explanation (cohort heterogeneity may be endpoint-definition artifact, not real biological heterogeneity)

phenotype_ontology.purpose: Map every cohort's reported outcomes into identical categories so that cross-cohort comparison is honest. NEVER infer a missing component.

R2-C1.name: Renewed objective ICP/IIH failure
R2-C1.definition: Post-VSS recurrence of objectively elevated intracranial pressure (opening pressure >25 cmH2O on lumbar puncture, OR continuous ICP monitoring showing elevated pressures) requiring escalation.
required_components: Objective ICP elevation confirmed by lumbar puncture or continuous monitoring
NOT explained by stent-adjacent restenosis alone (R2-C2 takes precedence if restenosis present)
forbidden_inferences: Cannot infer ICP elevation from symptom recurrence alone
Cannot infer ICP elevation from papilledema recurrence alone (could be other causes)
Cannot infer ICP elevation from 'required shunt placement' alone (could be visual failure R2-C4)

R2-C2.name: Recurrent/new stenosis
R2-C2.definition: Post-VSS angiographic demonstration of new stenosis (in-stent OR stent-adjacent) on catheter venography, with or without symptoms.
required_components: Post-VSS catheter venography (or MRV/CTV with confirmation)
Manometric gradient measurement preferred but not required if angiographic stenosis is clear

subtypes.R2-C2a: Symptomatic stenosis (with headache, visual symptoms, or papilledema recurrence)
subtypes.R2-C2b: Asymptomatic stenosis (incidental finding on routine follow-up angiography)

forbidden_inferences: Cannot infer restenosis from 'repeat stenting' alone (re-stenting could be for other indications)
Cannot infer restenosis from 'persistent headache' alone
Cannot infer restenosis from 'ICP elevation' alone (could be primary ICP failure R2-C1)

R2-C3.name: Headache + normal ICP + improved papilledema + no restenosis
R2-C3.definition: Post-VSS persistent or recurrent headache DESPITE objective ICP normalization AND papilledema improvement/resolution AND no angiographic restenosis.
required_components_ALL_FOUR_MUST_BE_PRE: Post-VSS persistent or recurrent headache (patient-reported, ideally with phenotype classification per ICHD-3)
Objective ICP normalization (opening pressure ≤25 cmH2O on lumbar puncture, OR continuous ICP monitoring showing normal pressures)
Papilledema improvement or resolution (per Frisén grade or neuro-ophthalmology assessment)
No angiographic restenosis (confirmed by catheter venography or MRV/CTV)
forbidden_inferences: CANNOT infer normal ICP from 'no repeat lumbar puncture' — measurement is required
CANNOT infer improved papilledema from 'no repeat ophthalmology visit' — measurement is required
CANNOT infer no restenosis from 'no repeat stenting' — imaging is required
CANNOT infer no restenosis from 'patent stent on fluoroscopy' — catheter venography is required
CANNOT infer R2-C3 from 'persistent headache' alone even if surgery was not performed

R2-C4.name: Visual failure despite controlled pressure
R2-C4.definition: Post-VSS progressive visual loss (perimetry, acuity, or color vision) DESPITE objectively normal ICP.
required_components: Post-VSS progressive visual loss documented by perimetry or acuity testing
NOT explained by optic nerve damage from pre-VSS papilledema (sequelae vs active disease)
forbidden_inferences: Cannot infer visual failure from 'persistent visual symptoms' alone (could be subjective)
Cannot infer visual failure from 'persistent papilledema' alone (that would be R2-C1 if ICP elevated)

R2-C5.name: Other persistent symptoms
R2-C5.definition: Post-VSS persistent symptoms (tinnitus, visual obscurations, diplopia, cognitive complaints) that do not fit R2-C1 through R2-C4.
required_components: Does not meet criteria for R2-C1, R2-C2, R2-C3, or R2-C4

UNKNOWN.name: Insufficient data to classify
UNKNOWN.definition: One or more required components are not measured or not reported. The case cannot be classified into R2-C1 through R2-C5 without inferring a missing component.
UNKNOWN.use_rule: When any required component is missing or not measured, classify as UNKNOWN. Do NOT default to the closest-fitting phenotype.

classification_rules.rule_1_priority_order: If multiple phenotypes could apply, classify by the most objective available criterion. R2-C2 (angiographic) > R2-C1 (ICP measurement) > R2-C4 (visual testing) > R2-C3 (requires all four) > R2-C5 (catch-all) > UNKNOWN.
classification_rules.rule_2_no_inference: NEVER infer a missing component. If ICP was not measured, classify as UNKNOWN (not R2-C3 even if headache + no restenosis + papilledema improved).
classification_rules.rule_3_one_phenotype_per_case: Each patient-case is classified into ONE phenotype. If multiple phenotypes coexist, choose the most clinically significant (R2-C1 > R2-C2 > R2-C4 > R2-C3 > R2-C5).
classification_rules.rule_4_temporal_distinction: R2-C1/C2/C3/C4/C5 are POST-VSS phenotypes. Pre-VSS symptoms are not classified here.

C1_Midtlien_2025.endpoint_definition: Three-group symptom trajectory classification: (1) sustained improvement without relapse, (2) temporary improvement with relapse, (3) no improvement. Retrospective review of prospectively maintained registry.
C1_Midtlien_2025.pressure_measurement_method: Lumbar puncture opening pressure (OP). Mean OP reduction 9.6 cmH2O reported for Group 2. NOT specified whether ALL patients had repeat LP or only a subset.
C1_Midtlien_2025.pressure_threshold_normal: NOT EXPLICITLY DEFINED in abstract. Implied ≤25 cmH2O (standard clinical threshold) but not stated. Group 2 mean OP reduction 9.6 cmH2O from baseline 31 cmH2O → post-VSS mean ~21.4 cmH2O (within normal range).
C1_Midtlien_2025.papilledema_definition: Neuro-ophthalmology assessment (method not specified in abstract). 75% of Group 2 showed 'papilledema improvement or resolution' — binary outcome, not graded.
C1_Midtlien_2025.restenosis_definition: NOT EXPLICITLY DEFINED in abstract. The 17% 'required further surgical intervention' is a proxy for symptomatic restenosis or treatment failure, but asymptomatic restenosis status is not reported.
C1_Midtlien_2025.headache_definition: Patient-reported symptom recurrence. NO ICHD-3 phenotype classification. NO distinction between migraine, tension-type, medication-overuse, or pressure-dependent headache.
C1_Midtlien_2025.follow_up_duration: Group 1 mean 166 days; Group 2 mean 390 days. Group 3 not specified.
C1_Midtlien_2025.patient_selection_criteria: Adults with severe, medically-refractory IIH; minimum 3-month follow-up. Single-center. 2012-2023.

phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C1_renewed_ICP_failure: UNKNOWN — Group 2 had mean OP reduction 9.6 cmH2O, but per-patient ICP normalization not confirmed. Some Group 2 patients may have persistent ICP elevation.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C2_recurrent_stenosis: UNKNOWN — 17% required further surgical intervention (proxy for symptomatic restenosis), but asymptomatic restenosis rate not reported.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C3_headache_normal_ICP_improved_pap_n: UNKNOWN — Group 2 (57%, 101/178) has the necessary CONDITIONS for R2-C3 (headache + ICP reduction + papilledema improvement) but per-patient joint confirmation is missing. Cannot confirm R2-C3 at the per-patient level. CANNOT infer 'no restenosis' from 'no surgery.'
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.UNKNOWN_count: 178 (all patients) — per-patient phenotype cannot be assigned without inferring missing components.

C1_Midtlien_2025.honest_summary: Midtlien 2025 establishes the GROUP-LEVEL ANOMALY (57% recurrence despite mean ICP reduction and 75% papilledema improvement). It CANNOT establish per-patient R2-C3 because restenosis status per patient is not reported.

C2_D_Amato_2025.endpoint_definition: Per-patient symptom improvement at 6 weeks and 6 months post-procedure. Headache, papilledema, tinnitus, visual disturbances each tracked. Re-stent group defined by symptomatic recurrence + new angiographic stenosis.
C2_D_Amato_2025.pressure_measurement_method: Lumbar puncture opening pressure. Per-patient OP available for 5/10 re-stent patients in Table 3 (others marked N/A). Group-level means in Supplemental Table 2.
C2_D_Amato_2025.pressure_threshold_normal: NOT EXPLICITLY DEFINED. Implied ≤25 cmH2O. Single-stent group post-op mean OP 21.6 cmH2O (within normal); re-stent group post-op mean OP 25.8 cmH2O (borderline).
C2_D_Amato_2025.papilledema_definition: Neuro-ophthalmology assessment (method not specified). Binary: present or absent.
C2_D_Amato_2025.restenosis_definition: EXPLICIT: 'angiographically demonstrable venous sinus stenosis on follow-up angiography' at 6 months. Per-patient location of new stenosis in Table 3 (re-stent group) and Supplemental Table 1 (asymptomatic).
C2_D_Amato_2025.headache_definition: Patient-reported symptom. NO ICHD-3 phenotype classification. Listed per-patient in Table 3 'Recurrent symptoms' column.
C2_D_Amato_2025.baseline_gradient: Mean 8.8 mmHg single-stent group; 7.4 mmHg re-stent group. (LOWER than Midtlien and Ahmed.)
C2_D_Amato_2025.patient_selection_criteria: Confirmed IIH + angiographically demonstrable VSS + venous pressure gradient >1 mmHg. Single-center. 2012-2023.

phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C1_renewed_ICP_failure: 1 patient in single-stent group had OP 40 cmH2O + papilledema recurrence + patent stent + no new stenosis. This is R2-C1 (objective ICP failure with patent stent). NOT R2-C3 as previously misclassified.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C2_recurrent_stenosis: 19/97 (19.6%) — 10 symptomatic (re-stent group) + 9 asymptomatic (Supplemental Table 1). Per-patient confirmed.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C3_headache_normal_ICP_improved_pap_n: 0 confirmed cases. The 1 patient with patent stent + no restenosis had ELEVATED ICP (OP 40) + papilledema recurrence — fails R2-C3 criteria. Other patients either had restenosis (R2-C2) or had symptom improvement (no R2-C3).
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.UNKNOWN_count: 97 - 19 (R2-C2) - 1 (R2-C1) = 77 patients with sustained improvement (no R2-C phenotype).

C2_D_Amato_2025.honest_summary: D'Amato 2025 has the most rigorous per-patient restenosis assessment (routine 6-month angiography). Confirms 19.6% restenosis rate. The 1 'patent stent but symptomatic' case is R2-C1 (ICP failure), NOT R2-C3. Zero confirmed R2-C3 cases in this cohort.

C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.endpoint_definition: ICD-10/CPT code-based outcomes at 1 year: persistent symptoms (headache ICD-10 R51, papilledema H47.1, tinnitus H93.A, visual disturbances H53-H54), repeat procedures (CPT 37238/37239/1009323), readmissions, ED visits. Propensity-score matched to CSF shunt cohort.
C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.pressure_measurement_method: NONE — TriNetX EHR data does not contain ICP measurements, opening pressures, or continuous ICP monitoring data.
C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.papilledema_definition: ICD-10 H47.1 code presence. NO grading (Frisén or otherwise). NO objective ophthalmology assessment.
C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.restenosis_definition: NONE — TriNetX cannot identify restenosis. Only 'repeat TVS stenting' (CPT 37238/37239) as a proxy for symptomatic restenosis requiring intervention. Asymptomatic restenosis completely uncaptured.
C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.headache_definition: ICD-10 R51 code presence. NO phenotype classification. NO distinction between migraine, tension-type, or pressure-dependent.
C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.baseline_gradient: NOT MEASURED — TriNetX has no catheter venography data.
C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.patient_selection_criteria: Adults with ICD-10 G93.2 (IIH) + CPT 37238/37239 (TVS stenting) between 2020-2025. Multi-institutional, multinational via TriNetX federated network.

phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C2_recurrent_stenosis: PARTIAL — 9.6% repeat TVS stenting captures SYMPTOMATIC restenosis requiring intervention. Asymptomatic restenosis uncaptured. True R2-C2 rate is HIGHER than 9.6%.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C3_headache_normal_ICP_improved_pap_n: UNKNOWN — CANNOT be classified. ICP not measured, papilledema not graded, restenosis not imaged. The 34.9% persistent headache could include R2-C3 cases, R2-C1 cases, R2-C2 cases, or R2-C5 cases. CANNOT infer R2-C3.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C4_visual_failure: UNKNOWN — visual disturbances coded but not objectively measured.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C5_other_persistent: UNKNOWN — tinnitus (6.7%) and visual disturbances (22.9%) persistent, but cannot be classified without other components.

C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.honest_summary: Intrapiromkul 2025 establishes that PERSISTENT SYMPTOMS after VSS are common at the population level (34.9% headache, 24.2% papilledema, 22.9% visual, 6.7% tinnitus). It CANNOT classify any patient into R2-C1 through R2-C5 because ICP, papilledema grade, and restenosis status are not measured. The 25% gap between headache persistence (34.9%) and repeat intervention (9.6%) is NOT evidence of R2-C3 — it could include R2-C1, R2-C2 (asymptomatic), R2-C3, R2-C4, or R2-C5 cases.

C4_Azzam_2024_meta.endpoint_definition: Pooled rates across 36 heterogeneous studies. Headache improvement, papilledema improvement, visual disturbance improvement, tinnitus improvement, treatment failure, complications.
C4_Azzam_2024_meta.pressure_measurement_method: VARIES across included studies — not standardized.
C4_Azzam_2024_meta.papilledema_definition: VARIES — binary or graded, depending on study.
C4_Azzam_2024_meta.restenosis_definition: Treatment failure rate (8.35%) used as proxy. Heterogeneous definitions across studies.
C4_Azzam_2024_meta.headache_definition: VARIES — patient-reported, ICHD not applied consistently.
C4_Azzam_2024_meta.follow_up_duration: VARIES — mean across studies not reported in abstract.

phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C1_to_R2-C5: ALL UNKNOWN — meta-analysis aggregates heterogeneous study-level data. Cannot classify any per-patient phenotype.

C4_Azzam_2024_meta.honest_summary: Azzam 2024 provides pooled AGGREGATE rates only. The 13% gap (21% persistent headache - 8.35% failure) is meta-analytic noise from heterogeneous study definitions. CANNOT classify any phenotype.

C5_Saber_2018_meta.endpoint_definition: Pooled rates across 24 heterogeneous studies. Stent survival, stent-adjacent stenosis, headache improvement, papilledema status.
C5_Saber_2018_meta.honest_summary: Saber 2018 provides pooled AGGREGATE rates only. The 9% gap (22.8% persistent headache - 14% stenosis) is meta-analytic noise. CANNOT classify any phenotype.

C8_Ahmed_2011.endpoint_definition: Per-patient symptom classification (headache mild/moderate/severe, papilledema grade mild/moderate/severe, visual acuity, visual fields). Per-patient stent procedure details. Per-patient recurrence details.
C8_Ahmed_2011.pressure_measurement_method: Lumbar puncture opening pressure AND continuous ICP monitoring via Rickham reservoir in select cases (the 3 R2-C3 cases specifically had Rickham reservoir confirmation).
C8_Ahmed_2011.pressure_threshold_normal: Implicit ≤25 cmH2O (standard clinical threshold). The 3 R2-C3 cases confirmed 'normal pressures' via Rickham reservoir continuous monitoring.
C8_Ahmed_2011.papilledema_definition: Per-patient graded (mild/moderate/severe). Neuro-ophthalmology assessment. Resolution explicitly stated for the 3 R2-C3 cases.
C8_Ahmed_2011.restenosis_definition: EXPLICIT: 'in-stent restenosis' = 0/52 (explicitly stated). 'Adjacent stenosis' = 6/52 (extrinsic compression adjacent to previous stent). Confirmed by catheter venography + manometry.
C8_Ahmed_2011.headache_definition: Per-patient classified (mild/moderate/severe). For the 3 R2-C3 cases: persistent headache after stent + 4-stent patient with continuous ICP monitoring showing normal pressures. Authors explicitly note 'suggesting another cause for their headaches' = pressure-independent headache.
C8_Ahmed_2011.follow_up_duration: Mean 2 years (range 2 months to 9 years). LONGEST follow-up of all cohorts.
C8_Ahmed_2011.baseline_gradient: Mean 20 mmHg trans-stenosis gradient (HIGHEST of all cohorts — strict high-gradient selection).
C8_Ahmed_2011.patient_selection_criteria: IIH + TSS on MRV + catheter venography and manometry confirming gradient. STRICT high-gradient selection. 2002-2010 (older era).

phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C1_renewed_ICP_failure: 1 patient (the 4-stent patient) had persistent elevated pressures (sagittal sinus 27-37 mmHg, gradient 12-18 mmHg) AFTER multiple stents — borderline R2-C1, but authors describe her as having 'normal pressures on intracranial pressure monitoring' eventually. Classification: PARTIAL R2-C1 → converted to R2-C3 once pressures normalized.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C2_recurrent_stenosis: 6/52 (11.5%) — ALL had adjacent stenosis (extrinsic compression). Per-patient confirmed. In-stent restenosis = 0/52 explicitly.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C3_headache_normal_ICP_improved_pap_n: 3/52 (5.8%) — DIRECT per-patient R2-C3 cases. Verbatim: 'Headache only persisted in 3 patients, 1 patient after 4 stents and 2 patients after 1 stent, both with resolution of papilledema and normal pressures.' Plus 1 additional case (subtemporal decompression for ongoing headache with normal pressures 6 months post-stent) — may be the SAME as one of the 3 or a 4th case. Conservative count: 3-4/52 = 5.8-7.7%.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.R2-C4_visual_failure: NOT REPORTED as a distinct phenotype.
phenotype_classification_after_harmoniza.UNKNOWN_count: 52 - 6 (R2-C2) - 3 (R2-C3) - 1 (R2-C1 borderline, classified as R2-C3) = 42 patients with sustained improvement (no R2-C phenotype).

C8_Ahmed_2011.honest_summary: Ahmed 2011 is the ONLY cohort that can classify R2-C3 at the per-patient level, because it has all four required components: per-patient headache status, per-patient ICP (including Rickham reservoir continuous monitoring in critical cases), per-patient papilledema grade with resolution status, and per-patient restenosis status (catheter venography). 3/52 (5.8%) confirmed R2-C3 cases.

harmonized_comparison.question: After harmonizing all cohorts into the same phenotype ontology, does the apparent cohort disagreement survive?

C1_Midtlien_2025_n178.reason: Restenosis status per patient NOT REPORTED. Cannot confirm 'no restenosis' for any individual patient. The 17% surgical intervention rate is a proxy for symptomatic restenosis but does not rule out asymptomatic restenosis in the other 83%.
C1_Midtlien_2025_n178.what_is_classifiable: Group-level recurrence anomaly (57% Group 2 with headache + ICP reduction + papilledema improvement at GROUP AVERAGE level).
C1_Midtlien_2025_n178.R2_C3_count: UNKNOWN (cannot be 0; cannot be 57%; truth is somewhere in between, but per-patient confirmation impossible from public abstract)

C2_D_Amato_2025_n97.reason: All four components measured per-patient: headache (Table 3), ICP (lumbar puncture OP, partial), papilledema (binary), restenosis (6-month angiography).
C2_D_Amato_2025_n97.what_is_classifiable: Per-patient R2-C1, R2-C2 confirmed. R2-C3 specifically = 0 confirmed cases.

C3_Intrapiromkul_2025_n1318.reason: TriNetX lacks ICP, papilledema grade, and restenosis imaging. Only ICD-10/CPT codes.
C3_Intrapiromkul_2025_n1318.what_is_classifiable: Population-level persistent symptom rates (headache 34.9%, papilledema 24.2%, tinnitus 6.7%, visual 22.9%) and repeat intervention rate (9.6%).

C8_Ahmed_2011_n52.reason: All four components measured per-patient: headache (classified), ICP (LP + Rickham reservoir continuous monitoring in critical cases), papilledema (graded), restenosis (catheter venography + manometry).
C8_Ahmed_2011_n52.what_is_classifiable: Per-patient R2-C1, R2-C2, R2-C3 all confirmed.

does_heterogeneity_survive_harmonization.reason: Of the 6 cohorts, only 2 can classify R2-C3 per-patient (D'Amato n=97 and Ahmed n=52). The other 4 (Midtlien, Intrapiromkul, Azzam, Saber) CANNOT classify R2-C3 per-patient because at least one of the four required components is missing. Therefore the apparent heterogeneity (Midtlien 57% vs Ahmed 5.8%) is NOT a comparison of the same endpoint. Midtlien reports GROUP-LEVEL recurrence (a broader category that COULD include R2-C1, R2-C2 asymptomatic, R2-C3, R2-C4, R2-C5); Ahmed reports PER-PATIENT R2-C3 (a narrow category). Comparing these two numbers is comparing apples to oranges.
does_heterogeneity_survive_harmonization.what_would_be_needed_to_test_heterogenei: A single cohort with per-patient R2-C3 classification AT SCALE (n>100) using the canonical ontology. No such cohort exists in the public literature today. The closest is D'Amato (n=97, per-patient classification possible, 0 R2-C3 cases) and Ahmed (n=52, per-patient classification possible, 3 R2-C3 cases). Combined: 3/149 = 2.0% per-patient R2-C3 rate. But this is from 2 small single-center cohorts with different selection criteria.

caveats: Only 2 cohorts can classify R2-C3 per-patient.
Different selection criteria (Ahmed strict high-gradient, D'Amato broad).
D'Amato's 0 may reflect shorter follow-up (R2-C3 emerges later) or different selection.
Ahmed's 5.8% may reflect older stent technology or different patient population.
The 2.0% combined estimate is NOT a population prevalence — it is a sample proportion from 2 small heterogeneous studies.
combined_per_patient_R2_C3_estimate.canonical_state: Per-patient R2-C3 prevalence = UNKNOWN. The 2.0% combined estimate is INFORMATIVE but not DEFINITIVE. Population prevalence requires a large multi-center cohort with per-patient R2-C3 classification using the canonical ontology.

gradient_hypothesis_test.hypothesis_HH-1: There exists a baseline venous pressure gradient threshold below which R2-C3 phenotype emerges.
gradient_hypothesis_test.previous_round_classification: EXPLORATORY (Round 56c) — Ahmed 20 mmHg → 5.8% R2-C3; Midtlien 14 mmHg → 57% group-level recurrence. Possible threshold 15-18 mmHg.
gradient_hypothesis_test.round_56d_directive: Do NOT compare Ahmed's 5.8% to Midtlien's 57%. Only test gradient after obtaining within-cohort observations where both baseline gradient AND R2-C3 status are observed per-patient.

C1_Midtlien_2025.has_per_patient_gradient: UNKNOWN — abstract reports median 14 mmHg (group-level). Per-patient gradient data NOT in public abstract.
C1_Midtlien_2025.has_per_patient_R2_C3_status: NO — R2-C3 cannot be classified per-patient (restenosis status missing).

C2_D_Amato_2025.has_per_patient_gradient: YES — Supplemental Table 2 has per-patient gradient data (mean 8.6 mmHg no-stenosis, 9.1 mmHg re-stenosis).
C2_D_Amato_2025.has_per_patient_R2_C3_status: YES — but 0 confirmed R2-C3 cases in this cohort.
C2_D_Amato_2025.reason: D'Amato has 0 R2-C3 cases. Cannot test gradient threshold for R2-C3 because there are no R2-C3 cases to stratify. Could test gradient threshold for R2-C2 (restenosis) instead — but that is a DIFFERENT hypothesis.

C3_Intrapiromkul_2025.has_per_patient_gradient: NO — TriNetX has no gradient data.

C8_Ahmed_2011.has_per_patient_gradient: PARTIAL — mean 20 mmHg reported (group-level). Per-patient gradient data not in the publicly extracted text. May exist in the full paper but not in the open PDF.
C8_Ahmed_2011.within_cohort_test_possible: PARTIAL — could test if the 3 R2-C3 cases had gradient data extracted. But the open PDF text does not provide per-patient gradient for these 3 cases. Only group-level mean 20 mmHg is available.
C8_Ahmed_2011.reason: Per-patient gradient data for the 3 R2-C3 cases is not in the publicly accessible PDF text.

gradient_hypothesis_test.HH-1_final_classification: UNKNOWN — CANNOT BE TESTED AT ZERO COST. No cohort has both per-patient gradient AND per-patient R2-C3 status available in publicly accessible data. The previous Round 56c inference ('Ahmed 20 mmHg → 5.8%; Midtlien 14 mmHg → 57%; possible threshold 15-18 mmHg') is RETRACTED as it compared non-equivalent endpoints (per-patient R2-C3 vs group-level recurrence).
gradient_hypothesis_test.what_would_be_needed_to_test_HH-1: A cohort with per-patient baseline gradient AND per-patient R2-C3 classification (all four components measured). This would require either: (a) access to Midtlien's raw dataset (RESTRICTED — paywalled), (b) a new prospective study with per-patient gradient + 4-component R2-C3 classification, or (c) re-analysis of D'Amato's raw data (which has gradient but 0 R2-C3 cases — would only test the negative side of the threshold).

verdict.combined_per_patient_sample_proportion: 3/149 = 2.0% (D'Amato + Ahmed combined; NOT a population prevalence)
combined_estimate_caveats: Different selection criteria (strict high-gradient vs broad)
verdict.does_cohort_heterogeneity_survive_harmon: CANNOT BE DETERMINED — apparent heterogeneity is comparing non-equivalent endpoints (group-level recurrence vs per-patient R2-C3).
verdict.HH-1_gradient_threshold_classification: UNKNOWN — retracted from EXPLORATORY. Cannot be tested at zero cost. No cohort has both per-patient gradient AND per-patient R2-C3 status in publicly accessible data.
verdict.HH-2_through_HH-5_classification: ALL EXPLORATORY — none can be tested at zero cost without per-patient phenotype classification in a large cohort.
verdict.mechanism_generation_status: BLOCKED — no change. The 3 confirmed R2-C3 cases (Ahmed 2011) establish EXISTENCE at the per-patient level. They do NOT establish: (a) population prevalence, (b) causal mechanism, (c) stratifying variables, (d) phenotype stability over time. Mechanism generation requires all four.
verdict.discovery_state: STILL IN DISCOVERY / HYPOTHESIS GENERATION. The cohort disagreement is real but cannot be explained at zero cost. The hidden variable that explains why some VSS cohorts show predominantly stenosis-associated relapse while others show substantial symptom recurrence despite sustained pressure improvement REMAINS UNKNOWN.
verdict.honest_negative_result: After 4 rounds of zero-cost search (56, 56b, 56c, 56d), the autonomous loop has reached the limit of what public data can establish about R2-C3. The phenotype EXISTS (3 confirmed per-patient cases). The population prevalence is UNKNOWN. The cohort heterogeneity is REAL but UNEXPLAINED. The gradient threshold hypothesis (HH-1) is UNKNOWN. Mechanism generation is BLOCKED.

next_move_options.description: PARK R2-C3 as REAL-BUT-UNRESOLVABLE-AT-ZERO-COST. Document the precise re-activation trigger: (a) a large multi-center cohort with per-patient 4-component R2-C3 classification using the canonical ontology, OR (b) CEO approval to lift the no-human-loop restriction and request Midtlien's raw dataset, OR (c) a future clinical trial (e.g., NCT06833424) posting per-patient outcomes.
next_move_options.value: Closes R2-C3 chapter honestly with the strongest evidence base achievable at zero cost.

next_move_options.description: Pivot to a different RES-N problem with accessible per-patient data. R2-C3 has been characterized as far as zero-cost evidence allows. The autonomous invention loop should select a different problem territory.

Escalate to CEO: the autonomous loop has reached an epistemic boundary. R2-C3 is real but cannot be characterized further without either (a) lifting the no-human-loop restriction, or (b) accepting group-level evidence (which violates the no-inference rule). This is an Article XXXIV moment: reality is the next bottleneck.
next_move_options.value: Forces a constitutional decision: maintain the no-inference rule (and park R2-C3) or relax it (and proceed with mechanism generation based on group-level evidence).

verdict.recommended_next_move: NM-1 (PARK) followed by NM-2 (PIVOT) or NM-3 (ESCALATION) depending on CEO preference. The autonomous loop has done what it can.
